sentence: This project offers services that help investigators measure body composition, energy expenditure and metabolic function in clinical nutrition and obesity research.
This project collects a large set of brain images from people with schizophrenia and shares it online to study the causes of brain imaging abnormalities.
This project studies how macrophages that sit next to nerve fibers in the prostate affect prostate growth during development.
This project builds a microfluidic tool that isolates stem cells from patients with sickle cell disease for use in gene therapy.
This project tests whether a nanoparticle delivery system is safe and can work with other immunotherapies against tumors.
This project studies how an immune checkpoint receptor controls T cell function, using structural biology and antibodies to see how it binds its ligands.
This project tries to find out how circulating proteins damage implantable biomaterials used in children's heart surgery and lead to calcification.
This project searches for approved drugs that could help patients whose bodies make too little of a substance that helps neurons survive.
This project studies how human behavior and behavioral risk factors affect disease, including addiction, cancer, stress and aging.
This project studies the metabolic vulnerabilities of diffuse midline glioma, a brain tumor in children, to find a combination therapy.
This project studies how suicidal thoughts and behaviors spread among young adults on social media and tries to find risk factors that can be changed.
This project studies the structure of sterol 14α-demethylases, a catalyst, and how it interacts with partner proteins and biological membranes.
This project studies how inflammation from diet and obesity changes metabolism and speeds up cancer development in early-onset colorectal cancer.
This project builds a tool that maps proteins in 3D at many scales and colors, and tests it on mouse retina tissue.
This project studies the gene networks that control the very different craniofacial development of a group of pupfishes.
This project looks for treatment targets in acute myeloid leukemia stem cells that carry mutations in a certain pathway.
This project studies how bacteria use ubiquitin-like conjugation to defend against phages, to better understand immune signaling in humans.
This project tries to develop therapies for lung cancers that depend on mutations in certain genes.
This project tries to find out how cancer and cardiovascular disease interact and promote one another, and how to target their shared biology.
This project studies which clinical factors and genomic variants are linked to bicuspid aortic valve aortopathy, using predictive modeling and whole genome sequencing.
